title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2490 of 3 November 2026 amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain specific restrictive measures directed against certain persons and entities associated with the ISIL (Da'esh) and Al-Qaida organisations

paras.text: Official Journal of the European Union
EN L series

sections.heading: amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain specific restrictive measures directed against certain persons and entities associated with the ISIL (Da'esh) and Al-Qaida organisations

paras.text: THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION,
paras.loc: amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 1

paras.text: Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union,
paras.loc: amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 2

paras.text: Having regard to Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 of 27 May 2002 imposing certain specific restrictive measures directed against certain persons and entities associated with the ISIL (Da'esh) and Al-Qaida organisations ( 1 ) , and in particular Article 7(1), point (a), and Article 7a(5) thereof,
paras.loc: amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 3

paras.text: Whereas:
paras.loc: amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 4
amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 5

paras.text: Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 lists the persons, groups and entities covered by the freezing of funds and economic resources under that Regulation.
paras.loc: amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 6
amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 7

paras.text: On 24 October 2026, the Sanctions Committee of the United Nations Security Council pursuant to Resolutions 1267(1999), 1989(2011) and 2253(2015) decided to remove three entries from the list of persons, groups and entities to whom the restrictive measures should apply.
paras.loc: amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 8
amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 9

paras.text: On 26 October 2026, the Sanctions Committee of the United Nations Security Council pursuant to Resolutions 1267(1999), 1989(2011) and 2253(2015) decided to amend the identifying data for three entries in the list of persons, groups and entities to whom the restrictive measures should apply.
paras.loc: amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 10
amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 11

paras.text: Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 should therefore be amended accordingly,
paras.loc: amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 12

paras.text: HAS ADOPTED THIS REGULATION:
paras.loc: amending for the 364th time Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 imposing certain, para 13

paras.text: Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 is amended in accordance with the Annex to this Regulation.
This Regulation shall enter into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union .
This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.
Done at Brussels, 3 November 2026.
For the Commission,
On behalf of the President,
Director-General
Directorate-General for Financial Stability, Financial Services and Capital Markets Union
( 1 ) OJ L 139, 29.5.2002, p. 9 , ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2002/881/oj .
